steps.name: reveals
steps.expr: const ids=['btn-lens-reveal','btn-att-reveal','btn-rope-reveal','btn-kv-reveal','btn-zs-reveal','btn-punct-reveal','btn-typos-reveal','btn-ner-reveal','btn-qa-reveal','btn-lr-reveal'];ids.forEach(i=>document.getElementById(i).click());return ids.map(i=>i+':'+document.getElementById(i).textContent).join(' ')+' | hidden left: '+document.querySelectorAll('[hidden]').length+' | veils: '+document.querySelectorAll('.veil').length+' | cost rows: '+document.querySelectorAll('#costs-0 tbody tr').length+' | score on: '+document.querySelectorAll('#score .row.on').length+'/'+document.querySelectorAll('#score .row').length

steps.name: rope
steps.expr: const m=document.getElementById('rope-m'), s=document.getElementById('rope-s'); s.value=500; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const a=document.querySelector('#rope-rope .v').textContent; s.value=990; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return 'rope score at +500: '+a+' at +990: '+document.querySelector('#rope-rope .v').textContent+' | learned: '+document.querySelector('#rope-learned .v').textContent+' | err: '+document.getElementById('rope-err').textContent

steps.name: attention
steps.expr: const l=document.getElementById('att-layer'); l.value=12; l.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.querySelector('#att-sink-tgl [data-m=off]').click(); return 'layer '+document.getElementById('att-layer-v').textContent+' head '+document.getElementById('att-head-v').textContent+' | chart svg: '+document.querySelectorAll('#att-chart svg').length

steps.name: verbalizer
steps.expr: const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#vb button')].find(x=>x.textContent.startsWith('politics')&&x.dataset.c==='0'); b.click(); return document.getElementById('vb-acc').textContent.slice(0,80)+' | python politics: '+D.zeroShot.poolCheck.politics.accuracy

steps.name: kv
steps.expr: for(let i=0;i<6;i++) document.getElementById('kv-step').click(); const a=document.getElementById('kv-eval').textContent; document.querySelector('#fig-kv-btns [data-m=cache]').click(); return 'no cache evaluated: '+a+' | cache: '+document.getElementById('kv-eval').textContent+' needed '+document.getElementById('kv-need').textContent

steps.name: ner-writer
steps.expr: const t=document.getElementById('ner-inline'); t.value='[ORG Mars] landed'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return document.getElementById('ner-inline-out').textContent.slice(0,120)

steps.name: svgText
steps.expr: let bad=[]; for (const sv of document.querySelectorAll('svg')) { const r=sv.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width===0) continue; const vb=sv.viewBox.baseVal; for (const t of sv.querySelectorAll('text')) { if (t.getAttribute('transform')) continue; const b=t.getBBox(); if (b.x < -2 || b.x+b.width > vb.width+2 || b.y < -2 || b.y + b.height > vb.height + 2) bad.push((sv.parentElement.id||sv.parentElement.className)+':'+t.textContent.slice(0,25)); } } return bad.length? 'clipped: '+bad.slice(0,12).join(' | ') : 'no clipped svg text'

steps.name: svgOverlap
steps.expr: let bad=[]; for (const sv of document.querySelectorAll('svg')) { if (sv.getBoundingClientRect().width===0) continue; const ts=[...sv.querySelectorAll('text')].filter(t=>!t.getAttribute('transform')).map(t=>({t:t.textContent,b:t.getBBox()})); for (let i=0;i<ts.length;i++) for (let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++) { const a=ts[i].b,b=ts[j].b; if (a.width&&b.width&&a.x<b.x+b.width-2&&b.x<a.x+a.width-2&&a.y<b.y+b.height-2&&b.y<a.y+a.height-2) bad.push((sv.parentElement.id||'?')+': '+ts[i].t.slice(0,18)+' / '+ts[j].t.slice(0,18)); } } return bad.length? 'overlaps: '+bad.slice(0,14).join(' | ') : 'no overlapping svg text'
